available.quote: The board may grant a license or certificate to an applicant holding a license or certificate in good standing in another state whose requirements for licensure and certification are equal to or greater than those required by this chapter if the board has authorized an exam waiver agreement with the State.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license or certificate in good standing in another state with requirements equal to or greater than SC requirements; board must have authorized an exam waiver agreement. Technical exam may be waived if applicant passed an essentially equivalent exam in another state. SC Commercial Contractors Business, Law and Project Management exam may still be required.
requirements.quote: An applicant may exempt the technical examination required for certification if the applicant can verify passing an examination in another state which is essentially the same as the examination required by the department regardless of the absence of a reciprocal agreement with that state.
